stem: 200 people applied for a job at the municipal hall. 45% of them passed the written test. Of those who passed, 20% were hired. How many people were hired?
hints: There are two groups. First find how many passed. The 20% is taken from that smaller group, not from all 200.
90 people passed. Find 10% of 90, then double it to get 20%.

solution.methodName: Percent of a percent: find the first group, then take the percent of that group

steps.action: The 20% is of the 90 who passed.
steps.why: "Of those who passed" tells you the base is 90, not 200.

trapNotes.40: This is 20% of all 200 applicants. The 20% is only of the 90 who passed.
trapNotes.50: This subtracts the percents (45% − 20% = 25%) and takes 25% of 200. Percents of different groups cannot be subtracted.
trapNotes.72: This is the number who passed but were not hired (90 − 18).
